Name: Craftable Diagonal Floors
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Ever wanted to build a diagonal walking path that actually feels, well, diagonal? Now you can!

Each one of these crafting recipes now comes with four more for diagonals:
[list]
[*]Wood Floor
[*]Stone Floor
[*]Weathered Floor
[*]Crystal Floor
[*]Straw Floor
[*]Brick Floor
[*]Rustic Plank Floor
[*]Stone Walkway Floor
[/list]
Diagonal tiles are functionally equivalent to base game tiles.

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/emurphy42/CraftableDiagonalFloors]Source code[/url]﻿
[/list]
